name: Mixed Pack
description: Six 250 ml cans of Thynkers Lyquid Gotukola sparkling drink, mixed your way from Matcha, Mango & Passion and Pineapple. Made in Sri Lanka by CFB.
summary: Six cans, your way. Mix Matcha Original, Mango & Passion and Pineapple however you like.
story: Choose any six cans from the range: two of each, all one flavour, or whatever mix suits you. Build your mix right here, on any flavour’s page, and it’s sent with your enquiry.
Each can carries our signature gotu kola infusion, crafted for clear thinking and mindful energy.
finish: Powered by gotu kola. Mixed your way.
